title: Graph and feature-only learning in a retrospective Chinese A-share sanction benchmark: document overlap and financial-source sensitivity — reproducibility archive
description: Source and aggregate supplement for PeerJ Computer Science manuscript CS-2026:06:141707 (first revision, R1). Includes frozen predecessor evidence, the 105-fit sensitivity programme, strict replay records, the separately specified ten-fit 42-input extension and the separately specified 20-fit conservative RPT-record-incidence sensitivity with its paired bootstrap differences, a separately specified 20-fit earlier evaluation window (W2) and a precision summary of all paired comparisons. Public checks verify existing aggregates, interval endpoints and interfaces, not private empirical reconstruction. Code licensing is subject to RIGHTS_AND_NOTICES.md.
